tolerance.microjax: CPU public backend exposes fixed settings; no tolerance argument

trajectory_convention.microlux_microjax: add pi to alpha to map the same physical trajectory to their (tau+i*u0)*exp(i*alpha) convention

value_api.microlux: microlux.model.binary_mag(times and physical parameters, vector call)
value_api.microjax: microjax.inverse_ray.lightcurve.mag_binary(w_points,...,backend='cpu'); vectorized JAX time-to-w transform in same call

value_plus_gradient_api.microlux: jax.jacfwd(has_aux=True) of the vector-valued public binary_mag call
value_plus_gradient_api.microjax: jax.jacfwd(has_aux=True) of the vector-valued public mag_binary CPU call
value_plus_gradient_api.autodiff_vbm: jax.jacfwd(has_aux=True) of the vector-valued public BinaryLightCurve call
value_plus_gradient_api.lcbinint: single public holonomic_gradient batch call returning both mu and grad_mu
